functionSemantics.integer: Number(first); safe integer result or INTEGER_CONVERSION_FAILED.
functionSemantics.boolean: Accept true, false, string true/false, number 1/0, or string 1/0; otherwise BOOLEAN_CONVERSION_FAILED.
functionSemantics.json: First arg must be a string parsed by strict JSON limits; otherwise JSON_CONVERSION_FAILED.
functionSemantics.join: First arg must be an array; String each element and join with optional String(separator), default comma; otherwise JOIN_REQUIRES_ARRAY.
functionSemantics.concat: All args must be arrays and are flattened one level in argument order; otherwise CONCAT_REQUIRES_ARRAYS.
functionSemantics.coalesce: Return first arg other than undefined, null or empty string; zero, false and empty array are present.
functionSemantics.omitEmpty: Return omit sentinel only for undefined, null, empty string or empty array; preserve zero, false and objects.
functionSemantics.orientationForRatio: Positive decimal W:H string; portrait if width is less than height, otherwise landscape; invalid yields ORIENTATION_RATIO_INVALID.
functionSemantics.mediaUrlByRole: Two args: media array and nonempty role string. Exact role match; zero returns undefined, one returns URL, multiple yield MEDIA_ROLE_AMBIGUOUS.
functionSemantics.mediaUrlsByRole: Two args: media array and nonempty role string. Exact role match; return URLs in input order or empty array.

rules.expression: Exactly one operator and only its declared companion fields; unknown dollar keys fail validation.
rules.reference: Only exact allowlisted paths, their descendants, and a lexically scoped map alias may be read; missing paths yield undefined.
rules.presence: Default, if and coalesce treat only undefined, null and empty string as absent. False, zero and empty arrays are present.
rules.omit: Explicit omit and omitEmpty of undefined, null, empty string or empty array remove object fields and array entries. Other undefined values also remove object fields but remain undefined array entries.
rules.media: Non-array media or empty role yields MEDIA_ARGUMENT_INVALID; non-object item or non-string role yields MEDIA_ITEM_INVALID; matching missing/empty URL yields MEDIA_URL_INVALID. Single role lookup fails on multiple matches; plural lookup preserves input order and returns an empty array on zero matches.
rules.json: Strict JSON parsing rejects duplicate and unsafe keys, invalid Unicode, excess size or depth, and malformed JSON.
rules.diagnostic: Errors expose phase, stable reason and template path; messages never include media URLs, request values or secret payloads.
